X1 excavator: the complete machine, current revisions

J9 tracks on the X1 revision F X-frame · THK RU66 slewing ring · R3 turntable and swing drive · body B1 rev B with the main board rev B · R12 Rev. D4 arm on the new B01X mount · 1:15 Cat 320

Mode

    Travel and swing play in real time and are kinematic. The arm replays R12's MuJoCo dig cycle (150 g payload) at 20× real time, because the leadscrew drives move at most 0.8 mm/s. The clock above shows real elapsed time.

      The installation sequence of ASSEMBLY.md: each step's parts move in along their fitting direction; the halves and the hatch are built on the bench (shown beside the machine) and then go on as one. Connector and battery-pack models are named on the labels; the full list is in CONNECTORS.md.

      Boom pair (2 drives)
      extend: boom up
      Stick drive
      extend: stick in (crowd)
      Bucket drive
      extend: bucket curls
      Swing
      + = to the left (cab side); the pinion turns 4:1
      Travel
      both tracks; chain, sprocket, idler and rollers turn with it
